findings.governingReading: After weighing the conflict, Shirou concludes that he is worried about Sakura after all.
findings.explanation: The return to his underlying priority is flattened into a contextless statement.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to rest easy while I’m lying in bed unless I’m sure she’s all right
findings.evidenceJa: 一晩寝込む事になるなら、うちに帰って桜の様子を見ておかないと安心できない
findings.governingReading: Because the treatment will leave him bedridden overnight, Shirou must first return home and check Sakura himself.
findings.explanation: The English turns checking her into the state of being sure and weakens the causal need to return before incapacitation.

findings.governingReading: Shirou reads Rin as exasperated with him.

findings.evidenceJa: ハンガーにかけてあったコートを羽織る
findings.governingReading: Rin puts on the coat that had been hanging on a hanger.
findings.explanation: The concrete action and room object are reduced to putting on an unspecified coat.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to have to keep remembering this
findings.evidenceJa: 思い出すのも癪だから
findings.governingReading: Rin says even recalling the matter irritates or galls her.
findings.explanation: The emotional sting becomes reluctance to remember repeatedly.

findings.highlight: I don’t know where you made your mistake or what your misunderstanding is
findings.evidenceJa: 何処でどう間違えて、何をどう勘違いしているかは知らないけど
findings.governingReading: Rin leaves open where and how the instruction or understanding went wrong.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the mistake directly to Shirou, narrowing an uncertainty that also implicates his teaching.

findings.evidenceJa: ずんずんと廊下を歩いていく
findings.governingReading: Rin strides forcefully down the hallway.
Shirou leaves the historic Tohsaka residence.
findings.explanation: A building marked by history becomes the family or domestic unit.
